name: nodered-mcp
description: Control a Node-RED instance from your AI client: list/create/update/delete flows, trigger inject nodes, and manage the palette (install/uninstall/enable/disable nodes).

nodered_url.title: Node-RED URL
nodered_url.description: Base URL of your Node-RED instance, e.g. http://localhost:1880 (adjust the port if Node-RED runs in Docker).

nodered_token.title: Node-RED API token
nodered_token.description: Bearer token if adminAuth is enabled. Leave empty for a Node-RED without admin auth.

backup_dir.title: Backups folder
backup_dir.description: Where flow snapshots are written before every mutating operation.

read_only.title: Read-only mode
read_only.description: Expose only the tools that cannot modify Node-RED. Recommended when pointing at a production instance: flows can be inspected and diagnosed, but not deployed, installed, or injected.
